subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept Google Chat per-DM-thread sessions as the optional `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` mode using the inbound-envelope `parentPeer` SDK helper, or consolidate this with another Google Chat thread-routing direction?
rationale: The branch adds public config and SDK surface, overlaps two open Google Chat thread/reply PRs, and changes session and delivery behavior in ways automation should not choose without maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept This Shape After Repair
options.body: Keep `threadSessions` as an off-by-default Google Chat option, keep the `parentPeer` helper promotion, and require rebase, generated baselines, and current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate With A Canonical Thread PR
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers prefer one canonical implementation that settles naming, group-vs-DM scope, reply delivery, and SDK shape together.

options.title: Limit Scope To Reply Delivery
options.body: Do not accept a new session config mode yet and focus current Google Chat work on the narrower reply-delivery fix path.

recommendation.title: Accept This Shape After Repair
recommendation.body: Keep `threadSessions` as an off-by-default Google Chat option, keep the `parentPeer` helper promotion, and require rebase, generated baselines, and current-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice crosses the public plugin SDK helper boundary and routing/session behavior where recent history points to steipete as a strong area owner signal.
